status: specification; nothing registered or run under this registry

common.interval: 95% unit-cluster bootstrap, 2,000 draws, seed fixed at registration
common.weighting: primary estimate is the unit mean; the episode mean is reported beside it
common.cost: wells and turnaround days; compute and provider spend reported separately
common.registration: research/protocol_v2/registry.py register from a clean commit

E-DATA1.question: does any development task and measured-condition menu have enough headroom and units for planner work
E-DATA1.task: transcriptomic MoA-class discrimination (proxy; does not test prerequisite repair)
E-DATA1.units: SciPlex3 skeleton units; L1000 components; identical across menus

thresholds.menu_expansion_qualifies: delta oracle ceiling >= 0.02 with lower bound > 0, or fixed* -0.1 measurements with correct >= -0.01 and wrong <= +0.005

E-DATA1.failure_rule: stop planner-superiority work on these data; keep tasks as regression tests; next step is a data census

E-CAL1.question: do wrong-elimination forecasts or a registered bound cover observed rates on selected actions, per step and per episode, across studies
items: executed QC-passed steps of belief, safe, myopic_edv
episode-level cumulative false elimination among decided episodes
E-CAL1.stop_gate: covers overall and >= 95% of strata (n >= 20) on both LOSO targets, no stratum significantly above, and mean bound <= 3 x observed
E-CAL1.failure_rule: no forecast-driven stop and no risk claim

models: M1 pooled over dose within time
endpoints: held-out log loss and Brier of registered labels

b_deployable_realisation.missing: engagement or proximal function measured at the task dose, time and cell line before the candidate action, >= 50 units

stage0_census.inputs: premise releases and capability coverage only; no engagement value

stage1_arms.A0a: registry-expanded one-shot selection (same capabilities admitted in advance)
stage1_arms.A0b: exact contingent optimum over the closed legal space (same declarations)

E-AG1.shared: typed admission, licensing rules, budget, capability registry

endpoints.construction: capability evaluations per licensed decision on a registry with >= 100 offers
scoring: kinobeads final test where a partition exists

E-AG1.pass: A1 over-deferral <= A0a - 0.10 (95% cluster CI > 0) with wrong actions no worse than +0.02 and no higher cost; or identical decisions with <= 50% of A0a's capability evaluations
E-AG1.note: A1 cannot beat A0b in a small enumerable space under matched information; matching A0b is efficiency, not superiority
E-AG1.current_evidence: replay gated-plan-engagement-20260927: A1 = A0a on 4 of 4 decisive cases (same decision, same cost); differs on ABL1/dasatinib (different licensed decision) and MCF7/AZD2014 (A1 cost 2.0 vs 0, both defer)

E-JOINT1.W0: class-conditional empirical frequencies of registered reading labels behind OutcomeForecaster
E-JOINT1.W1: candidate conditional predictor (ReferenceWorld structural kernel or a future engagement predictor)
E-JOINT1.permutation: swap forecasts between compounds within the same condition and support bin; applicability, menu and validator unchanged
E-JOINT1.endpoint_J: per-unit utility (+1 licensed correct, -2 wrong development action, 0 deferral) - 0.02 x cost units; higher is better
E-JOINT1.interaction: I = (J_A1W1 - J_A1W0) - (J_A0W1 - J_A0W0); exploratory unless power for I >= 0.8
missing: a code path that feeds OutcomeForecast to repair selection
a task whose prerequisite result or downstream readout is forecastable with >= 20 references per branch

EXT-1.trigger: a frozen candidate passes WM-G3 or AG-G2 on development
EXT-1.cohort: unopened study with >= max(500, units required) label-compatible units, or new discordance cases with condition-matched engagement

WM-G0.rule: simple baselines reproduce within +/-0.005 on leakage-controlled splits

WM-G1.rule: log loss >= 0.02 nats/step better than best simple baseline (CI > 0); observed/forecast wrong ratio in [0.67, 1.5] on both LOSO targets; competence flag separates error rates

WM-G2.rule: one-step regret >= 0.01 lower than best simple baseline (CI > 0) at <= +0.1 measurements

WM-G3.rule: paired correct vs fixed >= 0.02 with CI lower > 0; wrong <= +0.005; measurements <= +0.1; days <= +0.6; confirmatory units; sensitivity

WM-G4.rule: frozen G3 result reproduces on an unopened cohort

AG-G0.rule: genuine interpretation-prerequisite gap on development observations; a feasible measurement changes an evidence-supported decision

AG-G1.rule: trace shows identification, repair, verification against real results and scope-limited update

AG-G2.rule: E-AG1 stage-1 pass rule against A0a and A0b
AG-G2.status: INCONCLUSIVE: no additional algorithmic contribution identified

AG-G3.rule: frozen AG-G2 result reproduces on unopened units
